g.text: WS-H/I/S/E -> local ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source and native gates OPEN

text.tspan: shared-registration
Distinct wills can register in current PSTATE lists
with same VM testator; shared container cleared after
publication; exact native root liveness remains a
premise
strong-closure
Sync dispatch runs collector per PSTATE; rooted wills
mark noncapturing actions while testator stays weak;
strong barrier precedes concurrent local weak
functions
late-classifier
UNMARKED reads current header/mark; local classifier
finishes before its own weak preservation, not before
every other processor preservation
early-publisher
One processor may weak-mark shared testator before
other classifies; completed-copy replay avoids relying
on unfinished payload publication
semantics-and-platform
Manual grounds strong reachability and resurrection;
source witness is conditional intended-memory control
flow, not configured native reproduction or C memory-
model proof
input-witness
Same VM, two distinct lists/wills and one allocated
testator; root wills but not testator/action captures;
helper source and temporary root retirement must
qualify
source-interference
P0 classify -> publish and finish testator marking ->
P1 classify sees marked; valid source-model steps can
omit P1 from this epoch selection
decision-cut
Freeze all domains; classify after certified global
strong closure and before weak mutation; reuse
existing strong/weak barrier only if its prerequisites
refine
weak-publication
Weak publish allowed only after global decision
receipt; preserve all testator/copy/scan work and
existing list ordering; atomic reads alone do not
repair semantics
semantic-repair
Make selection independent of weak preservation order
for fixed strong snapshot; changes observable
callback/resurrection timing; not a transparent list
relocation optimization
semantic-determinism
Correctness/semantic repair is primary; no automatic
positive CPU-work saving against a correct baseline
phase-separation
Classification remains O(W); zero or one additional
barrier depending on certified reuse; skew and receipt
bookkeeping still count
bounded-retention
No fixed bytes/latency benefit; compare equivalent
epoch semantics, not faster execution of an incorrect
outcome
